title: EcoGEO: Trajectory-Aware Evidence Ecosystems for Web-Enabled LLM Search Agents
abstract: arXiv:2605.12887v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Web-enabled LLM agents are changing how online information influences search outcomes. Existing Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) studies mainly focus on individual webpages. However, agentic web search is not a single-document setting: an agent may issue queries, crawl pages, follow links, reformulate searches, and synthesize evidence across multiple browsing steps. Influence therefore depends not only on page content, but also on how pages are organized, connected, and encountered along the agent's browsing trajectory. We study this shift through Ecosystem Generative Engine Optimization (EcoGEO), which treats GEO as an environment-level influence problem for web-enabled LLM agents. To instantiate this perspective, we propose TRACE, a Trajectory-Aware Coordinated Evidence Ecosystem. translated_title: EcoGEO：面向网络增强型大语言模型搜索代理的轨迹感知证据生态系统
translated_abstract: arXiv:2605.12887v3 公告类型：replace-cross。摘要：具备网络访问能力的大语言模型智能体正在改变在线信息影响搜索结果的方式。现有的生成式引擎优化（GEO）研究主要聚焦于单个网页。然而，智能体化的网络搜索并非单文档场景：智能体可能会发出查询、抓取页面、跟踪链接、重新表述搜索，并在多个浏览步骤中综合证据。因此，影响力不仅取决于页面内容，还取决于页面如何沿着智能体的浏览轨迹被组织、连接和呈现。我们通过生态系统生成式引擎优化（EcoGEO）来研究这一转变，该方法将GEO视为面向网络增强型大语言模型智能体的环境级影响力问题。为了具体实现这一视角，我们提出了TRACE——一个轨迹感知的协同证据生态系统。给定一个推荐查询和一个虚构的目标产品，我们的方法构建了一个受控的证据环境，该环境协调智能体辅助的……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出EcoGEO框架，将生成式引擎优化（GEO）从单网页层面扩展为面向网络增强型LLM搜索智能体的环境级影响力问题，并设计了轨迹感知的协同证据生态系统TRACE，通过控制智能体浏览轨迹中证据的组织、连接与呈现方式来影响其搜索结果。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes EcoGEO, which reframes Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) as an environment-level influence problem for web-enabled LLM search agents, and introduces TRACE, a trajectory-aware coordinated evidence ecosystem that shapes agent search outcomes by coordinating how evidence is organized, connected, and encountered along the agent's browsing trajectory.
